settings.title: Settings
settings.models_catalog: Model catalog overrides (live repricing / add / hide)
settings.models_catalog_desc: Add models, override an existing model's base price, or hide a model — no code change or redeploy. List only the models you want to change; anything not listed keeps the plugin's built-in default price (safe floor). This sets the base price (official or channel benchmark price, depending on the business pricing basis); the user's actual charge = base price × group multiplier (the multiplier is configured under Groups, independently). Takes effect within ~1 min of saving (or reload the plugin under Plugins for instant effect).
settings.models_empty: No override entries yet. Click "Add model" to add a new or repriced model; otherwise everything uses the built-in defaults.
settings.models_field_enabled: Show in /v1/models (off = hidden, but still billed correctly)
settings.models_price_prio_label: Priority tier (optional; blank = standard ×2 for new models, built-in models keep their built-in tier)
settings.models_price_flex_label: Flex / Batch tier (optional; blank = standard ×0.5 for new models, built-in models keep their built-in tier)
settings.models_price_lc_label: Long-context tier (optional; whole request billed at multiplier once input exceeds threshold; blank = family default)

settings.openclaw_models_not_array: Preset must be a JSON array
settings.landing_pricing_desc: JSON object that drives the landing pricing tables. tables can replace built-in tables (claude-max / claude-aws / claude-kiro / openai); panels can add independent model tabs (key/tab/title/headers/rows). Each row's cells are: model (model/tag/tagStyle), official strike price (strike/note), deal price (strong/note/save; deal:true highlights the column), savings pill (pill), description (text). Leave empty to keep the built-in tables; changes apply on landing refresh.
settings.landing_pricing_invalid: Must be a JSON object containing a tables object or panels array
